# R4Realty - Noida Property Consultancy

R4Realty is a premium real estate advisory portal for property investments in Noida, Greater Noida, and Goa, led by Rajveer Singh. This file serves as a guide for AI agents and LLMs to understand the site's structure, available properties, and investment guides.

## Main Navigation

- [Home](https://r4realty.in/) - Main landing page with contact forms and location mapping.
- [All Projects](https://r4realty.in/projects) - Catalog of residential, commercial, and plot projects.
- [Blog & Guides](https://r4realty.in/blog) - Authoritative real estate guides and market reports.

## Projects

- [GYGY Mentis](https://r4realty.in/projects/gygy-mentis) - Commercial IT park & food court in Sector 140, Noida.
- [Mall of Expressway](https://r4realty.in/projects/mall-of-expressway) - Pre-leased commercial retail units in Pari Chowk, Greater Noida.
- [Vedic City Goa](https://r4realty.in/projects/vedic-city-goa) - Premium villa and farmhouse plots in North Goa.
- [Bhutani Belfair](https://r4realty.in/projects/bhutani-belfair) - Low-density luxury residential flats in Sector 150, Noida.
- [Sector 151 Farmlands](https://r4realty.in/projects/sector-151-farmlands) - Gated farmhouse plot community in Sector 151, Noida.
- [Sunrise City](https://r4realty.in/projects/sunrise-city) - Residential plots near Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida.
